query: I have a 49-year-old male with pulmonary embolism. Among male ICU patients 44–54 with PE, stratify diagnostic intensity during first ICU stay (distinct procedures in first 72 ICU hours) into quintiles and report average procedure count, hospital LOS and mortality%.
final_sql: SELECT p.gender, p.age, d.icd_code, COUNT(DISTINCT pr.procedure_id) AS procedure_count, AVG(i.los) AS avg_los, SUM(CASE WHEN p.dod IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT i.subject_id), 0) AS mortality_rate FROM patients p JOIN admissions a ON p.subject_id = a.subject_id JOIN icustays i ON a.stay_id = i.stay_id JOIN diagnoses_icd d ON a.subject_id = d.subject_id AND a.hadm_id = d.hadm_id JOIN procedures_icd pr ON a.subject_id = pr.subject_id AND a.hadm_id = pr.hadm_id AND pr.charttime BETWEEN i.intime AND i.intime + interval '72 hours' WHERE p.gender = 'M' AND p.age = 49 AND d.icd_code = '4599' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM age(CURRENT_DATE, p.dob)) BETWEEN 44 AND 54 GROUP BY p.gender, p.age, d.icd_code ORDER BY procedure_count DESC NULLS LAST, avg_los NULLS LAST, mortality_rate NULLS LAST;
